named_mechanism: Statistical replication of natural adhesive protein sequence features using monomer-composition features for hydrogel design
definition: Represent proteins through reduced chemical feature categories mapped onto monomer classes
Use statistical relationships between these composition features and adhesion outcomes
Generate candidate synthetic compositions within empirically supported ranges rather than exact sequence copying
assumptions: Monomer feed composition is a reasonable proxy for effective sequence-derived chemistry at formulation level
Glass adhesion at 10 s is the best-supported quantitative endpoint in the cleaned dataset
Optimization-dataset Glass (kPa)_max values reflect later-round design outcomes
invariants: Candidate compositions must be nonnegative and sum to 1
Interpretability should use actual monomer categories, not anonymous latent variables
Threshold analysis must explicitly distinguish observed regime from >1 MPa aspirational target
non_negotiable_steps: Audit data coverage and target definition
Assess optimization trajectories and top-performing candidates
State the limitation that >1 MPa is outside currently observed measured range if confirmed
